Indian Railways Approves Major Doubling Project in Maharashtra

Indian Railways has approved a project to double the railway line on the Chouk-Karjat section in Maharashtra at a cost of Rs 497 crore. This project is expected to boost both passenger and freight capacity in the region, benefiting Maharashtra and potentially Telangana. The initiative aims to enhance the operational efficiency and throughput of the railway network.
